description: Agent discovery listing: buy it in one x402 payment. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (POST /buy/listing, $290 in one payment), with the response schema and an example; POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. A free check first: POST the same body to /buy/listing/check (email required). Payable with x402 or MPP.

email.description: optional: where to send the files too; without it they are on the order status page

items.description: https URL that answers HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements
